description: Sends a message or reaction to a specific Chat conversation. Send `encoded_message_create_event`, an end-to-end encrypted event built with the Chat XDK. `content`, a plaintext message or reaction sent unencrypted, is only a fallback for a 1:1 conversation that X Chat can't encrypt because one of the two users has connected an enterprise app that reads their DMs; check that the recipient's `receives_your_chat` user field is `unencrypted` before using it. Otherwise a `content` send is refused, and retrying it won't help: HTTP 400 https://api.x.com/2/problems/encryption-required when the conversation can be encrypted or is a group (send `encoded_message_create_event` instead), 400 https://api.x.com/2/problems/xchat-setup-required when you haven't set up X Chat, 400 https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-xchat-setup-required when the recipient hasn't, and 403 https://api.x.com/2/problems/message-request-not-supported when it would be a message request. HTTP 503 https://api.x.com/2/problems/chat-permissions-unavailable means the check failed and nothing was sent; retry it. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. A recipient who cannot be messaged (closed inbox, system/notification account, or a 1:1 block) returns HTTP 403 with type https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-not-messageable.
